author: Totally Not Mark
description:
MERCH: https://totallynotmark.com/ // Over the past year and a half, myself and a team of wonderful artists banded together to remake Dragon Ball Super's first fight: Goku vs Beerus. The show's infamous Episode 5 collapsed due to horrific time constraints, so we wanted to try and give this part of the story the presentation it was never afforded.
